$comment: NON-NORMATIVE: Derived from spec/rlp.ts. See SPECIFICATION.md Section 4 for authoritative definitions.
title: RLP Task
description: A unit of work that an agent can complete for a reward

id.description: Unique identifier for the task. UUID v4 is RECOMMENDED.

description.description: Human and AI readable description of what the agent should do

verificationProcess.description: Criteria to verify agent output. SERVER-SIDE ONLY - MUST NOT be exposed to agents (see SPECIFICATION.md Section 10.7)

targetUrl.description: Optional URL providing context for the task

reward.description: The reward offered for completing the task

amount.description: Reward amount as a decimal string (preserves precision)

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the task is no longer valid

claimUrl.description: HTTPS URL where agents POST their completed work
